words.note: daily 是 every day 最直接、最精簡的近義說法之一。作副詞時表示『每天』；也可作形容詞，如 daily routine / daily exercise。
words.exampleZh: 她每天早餐前都做運動。

exercises.original: She checks her email every day before starting work.
exercises.zh: 她每天開始工作前都會查看電郵。
exercises.upgrade: daily · 每天；每日

options.explanation: weekly = 每週。頻率太低，不等於 every day。
daily = 每天。和 every day 完全對應，語氣簡潔自然。
annually = 每年。頻率完全不同。

exercises.original: The machine is cleaned every day to prevent dust from building up.
exercises.zh: 這部機器每天都會清潔，以免積塵。
exercises.upgrade: daily · 每天；每日

options.explanation: sometimes = 有時。沒有每日頻率。
regularly only = 只是定期。regularly 不保證每天。
daily = 每天。cleaned daily 是自然搭配。

exercises.original: He walks to the station every day instead of taking the bus.
exercises.zh: 他每天都步行去車站，而不是乘巴士。
exercises.upgrade: daily · 每天；每日

options.explanation: daily = 每天。最直接替換 every day。
once = 一次。沒有表達每天。

words.note: on a daily basis 比 daily 稍正式、較長，常見於工作、行政、報告或流程描述，表示某件事每天都會進行。
words.example: The figures are updated on a daily basis.

exercises.original: The support team reviews urgent requests every day.
exercises.zh: 支援團隊每天都會審查緊急要求。
exercises.upgrade: on a daily basis · 每天；每日地

options.explanation: once in a while = 偶爾。不是每天。
from time to time = 間中。不是固定每日。
on a daily basis = 每天。正式描述工作流程時非常自然。

exercises.original: Sales data are backed up every day to a secure server.
exercises.zh: 銷售數據每天都會備份到安全伺服器。
exercises.upgrade: on a daily basis · 每天；每日地

options.explanation: on a daily basis = 每天。data are backed up on a daily basis 是正式流程語境。
yearly = 每年。頻率完全不同。

exercises.original: The manager receives progress reports every day during the launch period.
exercises.zh: 推出期間，經理每天都會收到進度報告。
exercises.upgrade: on a daily basis · 每天；每日地

options.explanation: on a daily basis = 每天。during the launch period 的正式監察語境很自然。

words.note: each day 和 every day 很接近，但稍微更強調『每一個單獨的日子』。常見於逐日變化、每日任務或每天都有同樣安排的語境。
words.example: Each day brings a new set of challenges.
words.exampleZh: 每一天都會帶來一組新的挑戰。

exercises.original: Every day, the nurse records the patient's temperature at 8 a.m.
exercises.zh: 每天早上八時，護士都會記錄病人的體溫。
exercises.upgrade: each day · 每天；每一天

options.explanation: from time to time = 間中。不是固定每日。
some days = 有些日子。不是每天。
every week = 每週。頻率不同。
each day = 每天。逐日重複同一任務，特別自然。

exercises.original: The children receive a different reading task every day.
exercises.zh: 孩子們每天都會收到不同的閱讀任務。
exercises.upgrade: each day · 每天；每一天

options.explanation: each day = 每天。different task each day 強調每一天各自都有任務。

exercises.original: Every day, she writes down one thing she learned.
exercises.zh: 每天她都會寫下一件自己學到的事。
exercises.upgrade: each day · 每天；每一天

options.explanation: each day = 每天。one thing per day 的結構很自然。
once = 一次。沒有每日重複。

words.meaning: 每天、一天也不例外；每一天都
words.note: every single day 是 every day 的強調版本，特別突出『一天也沒有漏掉』。常用於抱怨、堅持習慣、強烈承諾或高頻重複。
words.example: He practises the piano every single day.
words.exampleZh: 他每天都練鋼琴，一天也不例外。

exercises.original: She calls her grandmother every day without fail.
exercises.zh: 她每天都會打電話給祖母，一天也不例外。
exercises.upgrade: every single day · 每天、一天也不例外；每一天都

options.explanation: occasionally = 偶爾。和 without fail 相反。
every single day = 每天、一天不漏。without fail 是最決定性的線索。

exercises.original: He has trained every day for the past six months and has not missed a session.
exercises.zh: 過去六個月他每天都訓練，從未缺席一次。
exercises.upgrade: every single day · 每天、一天也不例外；每一天都

options.explanation: weekly = 每週。和 not missed a session 的每日節奏不符。
every single day = 每天都、一日不漏。not missed a session 明確要求強調。

exercises.original: The alarm went off every day at exactly 6 a.m., even on weekends.
exercises.zh: 鬧鐘每天準時六時響，連週末也不例外。
exercises.upgrade: every single day · 每天、一天也不例外；每一天都

options.explanation: occasionally = 偶爾。和 even on weekends 不符。
every single day = 每一天都。even on weekends 強調沒有例外。

words.note: day after day 表示每天持續重複，常帶『連續很久』的感覺，有時帶疲乏、單調或強調持續性的語氣。它比單純 every day 更有連續感。
words.example: Day after day, the workers repeated the same task.
words.exampleZh: 工人日復一日重複同一項工作。

exercises.original: Every day, the same complaint appeared in the customer feedback.
exercises.zh: 日復一日，顧客意見中都出現同一投訴。
exercises.upgrade: day after day · 日復一日；一天又一天

options.explanation: once a week = 每週一次。頻率不同。
day after day = 日復一日。the same complaint repeatedly appearing 有明顯持續重複感。
from time to time = 間中。不是持續每天。

exercises.original: He sat at the same desk every day, doing the same repetitive work.
exercises.zh: 他日復一日坐在同一張桌前，做同樣重複的工作。
exercises.upgrade: day after day · 日復一日；一天又一天

options.explanation: day after day = 日復一日。same desk + repetitive work 強烈支持長期重複語氣。

exercises.original: Every day, the drought continued with no sign of rain.
exercises.zh: 日復一日，旱情持續，完全沒有下雨跡象。
exercises.upgrade: day after day · 日復一日；一天又一天

options.explanation: occasionally = 偶爾。不能表達持續旱情。
day after day = 日復一日。continued + no sign of rain 強調長時間逐日持續。
rarely = 很少。無法表達持續。

words.meaning: 日復一日；天天如此（常帶單調感）
words.note: day in, day out 是很自然的慣用語，表示每天長期重複同一件事，通常比 day after day 更口語，也更容易帶單調、疲憊或『老是這樣』的語氣。
words.example: She does the same paperwork day in, day out.
words.exampleZh: 她日復一日都做同樣的文書工作。

exercises.original: He answers the same basic questions every day at the help desk.
exercises.zh: 他在服務台天天都回答同樣的基本問題。
exercises.upgrade: day in, day out · 日復一日；天天如此（常帶單調感）

options.explanation: occasionally = 偶爾。不是天天重複。
once = 一次。沒有重複意味。
day in, day out = 日復一日。same basic questions + help desk 很符合長期重複、略單調的語氣。

exercises.original: Every day, she performs the same routine tasks in the warehouse.
exercises.zh: 她日復一日在倉庫做同樣的例行工作。
exercises.upgrade: day in, day out · 日復一日；天天如此（常帶單調感）

options.explanation: day in, day out = 日復一日。same routine tasks 是典型搭配。

exercises.original: The staff deal with the same complaints every day, which can become exhausting.
exercises.zh: 員工天天處理同樣的投訴，久而久之會很累。
exercises.upgrade: day in, day out · 日復一日；天天如此（常帶單調感）

options.explanation: day in, day out = 天天如此。same complaints + exhausting 明顯帶長期重複與疲乏感。

words.note: seven days a week 是帶強調意味的說法，表示星期一至星期日都如此，尤其適合營業時間、服務、工作安排或持續可用性。它比 every day 更明確強調週末也包括在內。
words.example: The service is available seven days a week.
words.exampleZh: 這項服務一星期七天都提供。

exercises.original: The pharmacy is open every day, including Sundays.
exercises.zh: 這間藥房每天營業，包括星期日。
exercises.upgrade: seven days a week · 一星期七天；每天都

options.explanation: seven days a week = 一週七天。包括星期日是最直接線索。
weekdays only = 只限平日。和 including Sundays 相反。
once a week = 每週一次。頻率完全不同。

exercises.original: Customer support is available every day of the week.
exercises.zh: 客戶支援一星期每天都提供。
exercises.upgrade: seven days a week · 一星期七天；每天都

options.explanation: weekdays only = 只限平日。漏了週末。
seven days a week = 一星期七天。every day of the week 是直接同義改寫。

exercises.original: During the festival, buses run every day, even at weekends.
exercises.zh: 節日期間，巴士每天行駛，連週末也不例外。
exercises.upgrade: seven days a week · 一星期七天；每天都

options.explanation: weekdays only = 只限平日。和 even at weekends 相反。
seven days a week = 一週七天。even at weekends 明確支持。
once a week = 每週一次。頻率完全不同。

falseSynonyms.zh: 日常的；普通的不等於一般的 every day everyday 是一個形容詞，修飾名詞，如 everyday life / everyday clothes；every day 是副詞片語，表示『每天』。兩者最容易混淆。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Everyday is an adjective; every day means 'each day'.

falseSynonyms.zh: 每天一次不等於一般的 every day once a day 只適合一天恰好一次的情況；every day 只表示每天都有發生，不限定一天發生幾次。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Once a day specifies exactly one occurrence per day.

falseSynonyms.zh: 每天；每日（作比率）不等於一般的 every day per day 通常用於速度、費用、數量或配額，如 $50 per day / three tablets per day；它不一般用來替代敘述習慣的 every day。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Per day expresses a rate, not usually a habitual frequency phrase.

falseSynonyms.zh: 一天一天地；逐日不等於一般的 every day from day to day 常表示情況逐日變化，或只按眼前一天一天過，不等於『每天都做某事』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON From day to day often describes changing conditions, not daily repetition.

falseSynonyms.zh: 一天比一天；按日不等於一般的 every day by the day 常表示程度逐日增加或按日計算，如 getting stronger by the day，並不是 every day 的一般同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON By the day often means 'progressively each day' or 'charged per day'.

falseSynonyms.zh: 每隔一天不等於一般的 every day every other day 表示隔日一次，也就是不是每天。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Every other day means on alternate days.

falseSynonyms.zh: 定期地；經常地不等於一般的 every day regularly 表示有規律地發生，但頻率可以是每週、每月或其他固定週期，不一定每天。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Regularly does not necessarily mean daily.

falseSynonyms.zh: 經常不等於一般的 every day often 只表示頻率高，但不保證每天發生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Often means frequently, not necessarily every day.
